# Keybinds

<!-- Generated by `archway keys generate` from `keybinds/keybinds.toml`. Do not edit. -->

Press `Super + /` at any time to open this list in a floating terminal.

## Apps

| Key | Action | Command |
|---|---|---|
| `super + Return` | Terminal (opens towards the cursor) | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet terminal` |
| `super + shift + Return` | Floating scratchpad terminal | `kitty --class floating-term` |
| `super + d` | Application launcher | `rofi -show drun` |
| `super + e` | File manager (Thunar) | `thunar` |
| `super + alt + e` | File manager (yazi, TUI) | `kitty --class floating-term -e yazi` |
| `super + ctrl + Return` | Choose the default terminal | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet terminal --pick` |
| `super + b` | Web browser | `${BROWSER:-firefox}` |
| `super + shift + p` | Run a command (archway, system tools) | `rofi -show run -display-name 'Archway'` |

## Navigation

| Key | Action | Command |
|---|---|---|
| `super + Tab` | Switch window (rofi) | `rofi -show window` |
| `super + h` | Focus west | `hyprctl dispatch movefocus l` |
| `super + j` | Focus south | `hyprctl dispatch movefocus d` |
| `super + k` | Focus north | `hyprctl dispatch movefocus u` |
| `super + l` | Focus east | `hyprctl dispatch movefocus r` |
| `super + shift + h` | Move window west | `hyprctl dispatch movewindow l` |
| `super + shift + j` | Move window south | `hyprctl dispatch movewindow d` |
| `super + shift + k` | Move window north | `hyprctl dispatch movewindow u` |
| `super + shift + l` | Move window east | `hyprctl dispatch movewindow r` |
| `super + alt + h` | Grow horizontally | `hyprctl dispatch resizeactive 20 0` |
| `super + alt + j` | Grow vertically | `hyprctl dispatch resizeactive 0 20` |
| `super + alt + k` | Shrink vertically | `hyprctl dispatch resizeactive 0 -20` |
| `super + alt + l` | Shrink horizontally | `hyprctl dispatch resizeactive -20 0` |

## Windows

| Key | Action | Command |
|---|---|---|
| `super + q` | Close focused window | `hyprctl dispatch killactive` |
| `super + f` | Toggle fullscreen | `hyprctl dispatch fullscreen 0` |
| `super + shift + f` | Maximize (keeps the bar visible) | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet window maximize` |
| `super + alt + f` | Toggle floating | `hyprctl dispatch togglefloating` |

## System

| Key | Action | Command |
|---|---|---|
| `super + alt + n` | keyd numpad layer on/off (CapsLock) | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet keyd toggle` |
| `super + alt + g` | Gaming mode (performance, DND, no idle) | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet gaming toggle` |
| `super + shift + b` | Bluetooth devices | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet bluetooth --rofi` |
| `super + shift + q` | Power menu | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet power --rofi` |
| `super + Escape` | Lock screen | `hyprlock` |
| `super + alt + r` | Reload Hyprland config | `hyprctl dispatch reload` |
| `super + shift + e` | Log out of the session | `command -v uwsm >/dev/null 2>&1 && uwsm stop \|\| hyprctl dispatch exit` |
| `super + slash` | Keybind cheatsheet | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway keys list \| rofi -dmenu -i -p Keybinds` |

## Workspaces

| Key | Action | Command |
|---|---|---|
| `super + 1` | Workspace 1 | `hyprctl dispatch workspace 1` |
| `super + 2` | Workspace 2 | `hyprctl dispatch workspace 2` |
| `super + 3` | Workspace 3 | `hyprctl dispatch workspace 3` |
| `super + 4` | Workspace 4 | `hyprctl dispatch workspace 4` |
| `super + 5` | Workspace 5 | `hyprctl dispatch workspace 5` |
| `super + 6` | Workspace 6 | `hyprctl dispatch workspace 6` |
| `super + shift + 1` | Move window to workspace 1 | `hyprctl dispatch movetoworkspace 1` |
| `super + shift + 2` | Move window to workspace 2 | `hyprctl dispatch movetoworkspace 2` |
| `super + shift + 3` | Move window to workspace 3 | `hyprctl dispatch movetoworkspace 3` |
| `super + shift + 4` | Move window to workspace 4 | `hyprctl dispatch movetoworkspace 4` |
| `super + shift + 5` | Move window to workspace 5 | `hyprctl dispatch movetoworkspace 5` |
| `super + shift + 6` | Move window to workspace 6 | `hyprctl dispatch movetoworkspace 6` |

## Archway

| Key | Action | Command |
|---|---|---|
| `super + space` | Theme selector | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet theme-selector --rofi` |
| `super + shift + m` | Mount / unmount Android device (MTP) | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet android-mount --rofi` |
| `super + v` | Clipboard history | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet clipboard --rofi` |
| `super + shift + n` | Wi-Fi menu | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet network --rofi` |
| `super + alt + w` | Wallpaper picker | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet wallpaper --rofi` |
| `super + shift + s` | Screenshot: region | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet screenshot region` |
| `super + shift + r` | Screen recording: start/stop | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet record toggle` |
| `super + period` | Emoji picker | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet emoji --rofi` |
| `Print` | Screenshot: whole screen | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet screenshot full` |
| `super + p` | Password manager (rbw) | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet password --rofi` |

## Media

| Key | Action | Command |
|---|---|---|
| `XF86AudioRaiseVolume` | Volume up | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet osd volume up` |
| `XF86AudioLowerVolume` | Volume down | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet osd volume down` |
| `XF86AudioMute` | Toggle mute | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet osd volume mute` |
| `XF86AudioMicMute` | Toggle microphone mute | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet osd mic mute` |
| `XF86AudioPlay` | Play / pause | `playerctl play-pause` |
| `XF86AudioNext` | Next track | `playerctl next` |
| `XF86AudioPrev` | Previous track | `playerctl previous` |
| `XF86MonBrightnessUp` | Brightness up | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet osd brightness up` |
| `XF86MonBrightnessDown` | Brightness down | `$HOME/.local/bin/archway applet osd brightness down` |
